_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 0% base rate of ±2+ moves across 37 consecutive 12h windows makes HOLD the only statistically honest call — the coil holds until either stablecoin growth revives retail participation or options skew breaks to signal deleveraging.
next_move.brains_agree: Split: analyst calls HOLD with medium conviction anchored to base-rate discipline; narrative implies directional reversal is imminent based on the August 2024 analog — the analyst's trust weight (7.67) and the judge's own base-rate read (7.50) both favor the HOLD call over the narrative's directional lean.
